items.title: Reddit Will Join the S&P 500 at a Crucial Time for the Stock
items.summary: Reddit  is joining the  at an important time for investors who want to see the social-networking site improve its daily active user growth and enter into additive data licensing deals with tech giants.  Reddit will replace  AvalonBay Communities  before the opening of trading on Tuesday, according to S&P Dow Jones Indices, which oversees the index.  The change was prompted by  Equity Residential’s  coming acquisition of AvalonBay, a large owner of multifamily housing.
